data.title: Lab recording set-ups
data.description: One row per lab: hardware and reference from the BIDS sidecars, how many people were recorded and analysed, mean age and share female, and lab means of accuracy, K, attention and CDA (analysed people). Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: Every person, every metric
data.description: One row per person (304): lab, recording, exclusion and why, behaviour (accuracy, K per set size, attention), CDA per set size, coherent fractions, trial-history carry-over, engagement-state shares and spectral traits. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: Person × set size
data.description: Per analysed person and set size: accuracy, median RT, share of clean trials, mean and SD of single-trial CDA, alpha lateralization and eye drift. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: Lab × set size
data.description: Per lab and set size, over analysed people's trials: accuracy, median RT, trial count, and on clean trials mean CDA, alpha lateralization, HEOG and gaze drift toward the cue. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: Behaviour over the session
data.description: Per lab (and all labs) and 5-minute bin from the first trial: accuracy, median RT, trial count and relative pre-trial alpha power. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: CDA waveforms by lab
data.description: Mean and standard error of the contralateral-minus-ipsilateral waveform, every 8 ms from -200 to 1300 ms, per lab and set size, over analysed people. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: CDA waveforms by person
data.description: Each person's average CDA waveform per set size (clean trials), every 8 ms from -200 ms; w holds the samples. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: Single-trial CDA spread
data.description: Counts of single-trial CDA amplitudes (300-900 ms, 1 µV bins from -30 to 30) per set size, all clean trials of analysed people. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: Spectrum of each person
data.description: Channel-median power spectrum of each person's recording at its native rate, before notch filtering, log10, 1-Hz bins from 1 to 125 Hz. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: Single-trial coherent fraction
data.description: Pooled over analysed people: share of a single trial's lateralized energy (300-900 ms) at each frequency that the leave-one-out condition average predicts. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: Missing-electrode prediction
data.description: Median over 30 held-out people of coherent fraction c, output level p and SNR when each electrode is predicted from the others, by method and band. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: lisa-rtm network on EEG
data.description: Scores of each bandwidth-extension model rebuilding 31-125 Hz from 0-31 Hz on 30 held-out people: deficit, coherent fraction, SNR, CRPS, gated levels and per-band curves. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: Capacity forecasts by lab
data.description: Leave-one-lab-out forecasts of K from four CDA features: correlations and CRPS skill against a know-nothing forecast, for the raw CDA, the CDA centred within lab, and the lab mean alone. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.

data.title: Tested ideas
data.description: One row per headline statistic of every idea tested (engagement, single-trial forecasts, trial history, early warnings, eyes, engagement states, spectral traits): value, t, p and a note. Exported from the lisa-rtm-eeg analysis.
